title: 第23章 许家的獠牙第24章 开业
content_zh:
;;
徐茂眼角斜飞，将白静上下扫量。
见其肌理丰盈若新剥荔肉，腰肢款摆似风拂垂杨，顿觉丹田邪火窜动，那等市井轻浮言语已在舌尖打转。
但中年管事眼睛毒辣，一眼看出他心中盘算，当前抱拳道：“许夫人见谅，我家公子心直口快，只是见那白猫好奇罢了。”
徐茂瞥了眼自家管事，瞧见其眼色挤弄，这才撇嘴作罢。
“还是大族出身，一点眼力都没有。”许明仙嘴角露出一抹讥讽之色。
“小娃你说什么！”
见一个小孩子都敢讥讽自己，徐茂顿时怒喝一声，猛然站起。
“你一个大人要跟我六岁顽童计较不成。”
许明仙和许明姝出生后，许家的家境早已不似最初的贫困。
许川夫妇还有上面的哥哥们都多有宠爱，性子多了几分顽劣，向来心直口快。
中年管事笑着问道：“小公子此前说我们没有眼力，何出此言？”
“我姐手里的可是猛虎的幼崽，你说是白猫，岂不是有眼无珠。”
中年管事一怔。
徐茂则哈哈大笑起来，“猛虎幼崽，当我没见过猛虎吗？哪有白色皮毛的。”
“把白猫当成猛虎，不愧是许川教出来的孩子。”
许明姝也是怒了，伸手指着徐茂，“小白，咬它。”
小白似乎听懂了许明姝的话，看向徐茂的赤金眸子，闪烁着凶光。
且张开嘴巴，露出还没长齐的虎牙。
“雪霁，要咬谁呢！”

“都说了不准让小白随意咬人！”
一道随和的声音从门外传来。
接着便见许川、许明巍、孙富贵、钱有才走进了院子。
门外七八位衣着简朴的壮汉，站在几辆板车前。
板车上是一筐筐的青玉梨。
“阿爹，你回来了。”
许明仙和许明姝喊着朝许川跑了过去。
白静心中松了一口气，也是露出笑容，“夫君回来了，徐公子他们已等候有一会儿了。”
许川点点头，看向徐茂，笑着道：“徐兄，许久不见啊。”
“阿爹，这个人刚才骂你。”
许明姝露出小虎牙，向许川打起了小报告。
“你这丫头。”徐茂横眉竖眼地瞪向许明姝，满脸怒气。

Xu Mao's eyes flew sideways, scanning Bai Jing up and down.
Seeing that its texture is as plump as freshly peeled lychee meat, and its waist is as swaying as a drooping willow in the wind, I suddenly feel the evil fire moving in my Dantian, and those frivolous words from the market are already swirling on the tip of my tongue.
But the middle-aged steward's eyes were sharp and he could see what was in his mind at a glance. He clasped his fists and said, "Mrs. Xu, please forgive me. My young master is outspoken. He is just curious about the white cat."
Xu Mao glanced at his steward and saw his winking, then he curled his lips and gave up.
"He is from a rich family and has no eyesight at all." Xu Mingxian had a sarcastic look on his lips.
"What did you say, little one!"
Seeing that a child dared to ridicule him, Xu Mao shouted angrily and stood up suddenly.
"You, an adult, have nothing to do with me, a six-year-old naughty boy."
After Xu Mingxian and Xu Mingshu were born, the Xu family's family situation was no longer as poor as it was at the beginning.
Xu Chuan and his wife, as well as the brothers above, are very doting, have a bit of a naughty temper, and have always been outspoken.
The middle-aged steward asked with a smile: "Young Master said before that we have no eyesight. Why did you say this?"
"What my sister is holding is the cub of a fierce tiger. If you say it is a white cat, are you being blind?"
The middle-aged steward was startled.
Xu Mao laughed loudly, "Tiger cubs, do you think I have never seen a tiger? There is no one with white fur."
"The child who mistook a white cat for a tiger is worthy of being taught by Xu Chuan."
Xu Mingshu was also angry and pointed at Xu Mao, "Xiaobai, bite it."
Xiaobai seemed to understand Xu Mingshu's words, and looked at Xu Mao's red gold eyes with a fierce light.
And he opened his mouth, revealing the tiger teeth that were not yet fully grown.
"Xue Ji, who are you going to bite?"
"I told you not to let Xiaobai bite anyone at will!"
An easy-going voice came from outside the door.
Then Xu Chuan, Xu Mingwei, Sun Fugui, and Qian Youcai walked into the courtyard.
Outside the door, seven or eight strong men in simple clothes stood in front of several carts.
On the cart are baskets of green jade pears.
"Dad, you are back."
Xu Mingxian and Xu Mingshu shouted and ran towards Xu Chuan.
Bai Jing breathed a sigh of relief and smiled, "My husband is back. Mr. Xu and the others have been waiting for a while."
Xu Chuan nodded, looked at Xu Mao, and said with a smile: "Brother Xu, long time no see."
"Dad, this person just scolded you."
Xu Mingshu showed her little fangs and made a small report to Xu Chuan.
"You girl." Xu Mao glared at Xu Mingshu with raised eyebrows, his face full of anger.
